name: Rachid Karami International Fair-Tripoli
description: In northern Lebanon, between Tripoli's old centre and the port of Al Mina, stands a 70-hectare fairground designed in 1962 by Brazilian architect Oscar Niemeyer. Its centrepiece is a boomerang-shaped covered hall, 750 metres long, built as open space for countries to stage exhibitions. Planned as a symbol of 1960s modernization, it is now listed as World Heritage in Danger.
